text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /tmp/mechanics-rollback-fix-1.py <<'PY'
import os,json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
task=root/'.ai/task/mechanics-rollback-20261003'
val=task/'fix-1-validation'
val.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
fix=json.loads((task/'FIX-1.json').read_text())
findings=fix['findings']
assert len(findings)==4 and all(x['status']=='confirmed' for x in findings)
assert [x['inventory_id'] for x in findings]==[51,73,82,118]
files=['mod-tome.lua','tome-orcs.lua']
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z']).decode().split('\0')
protected=[root/x for x in tracked if x and x not in files]
protected += [x for x in (root/'.ai').rglob('*') if x.is_file() and val not in x.parents]
protected += [root/'.artifacts/i18n/mechanics-rollback-20261003/executor-report.json']
protected_hash={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in protected}
index=root/'.git/index'
# git index may be located in a shared worktree git dir.
index=Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--git-path','index'],text=True).strip())
index_hash=sha(index.read_bytes())
env=os.environ.copy()
rocks=env['TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT']
env['LUA_PATH']=rocks+'/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;'+rocks+'/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;'
env['LUA_CPATH']=rocks+'/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;'
def load(path,out):
    r=subprocess.run([env['TOME_LUAJIT'],'tools/lua/load_locale.lua',str(path.relative_to(root)),str(out.relative_to(root))],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert r.returncode==0,(r.stdout,r.stderr)
    return [json.loads(s) for s in out.read_text().splitlines() if s]
inventory={r['id']:r for r in json.loads((task/'INVENTORY.json').read_text())['all_changed_records']}
proof=[]
changes=[]
prepared={}
for file in files:
    before=(task/'before-fix-1'/file).read_bytes()
    assert (root/file).read_bytes()==before
    expected=before
    rows=load(task/'before-fix-1'/file,val/(file+'.before.jsonl'))
    for f in [x for x in findings if x['file']==file]:
        inv=inventory[f['inventory_id']]
        assert inv['file']==file and inv['current']['source']==f['source'] and inv['current']['section']==f['section']
        matches=[(i,r) for i,r in enumerate(rows) if r.get('kind')=='translation' and r.get('section')==f['section'] and r.get('source')==f['source']]
        assert len(matches)==1
        i,r=matches[0]
        assert r['target']==f['old_target']
        old=f['old_target'].encode();new=f['new_target'].encode()
        assert expected.count(old)==1
        expected=expected.replace(old,new,1)
        changes.append(dict(f,record_index=i,line=r['line'],source_tag=r.get('source_tag'),args_order=r.get('args_order'),special=r.get('special'),inventory_baseline_target=inv['baseline']['target'],action='exact old_target -> new_target'))
    prepared[file]=(before,expected,rows)
# Every precondition has passed before either content file is written.
for file,(_,expected,_) in prepared.items():
    (root/file).write_bytes(expected)
for file,(before,expected,rows) in prepared.items():
    after=(root/file).read_bytes()
    assert after==expected
    reverse=after
    local=[x for x in changes if x['file']==file]
    for f in reversed(local):
        new=f['new_target'].encode();old=f['old_target'].encode()
        assert reverse.count(new)==1
        reverse=reverse.replace(new,old,1)
    assert reverse==before
    final=load(root/file,val/(file+'.after.jsonl'))
    assert len(final)==len(rows)
    allowed={x['record_index']:x for x in local}
    diffs=[]
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rows,final)):
        if a==b: continue
        assert i in allowed
        f=allowed[i]
        assert b==dict(a,target=f['new_target'])
        diffs.append({'record_index':i,'finding_id':f['id'],'changed_fields':['target'],'all_other_fields_identical':True})
    assert len(diffs)==len(local)
    proof.append({'file':file,'before_sha256':sha(before),'after_sha256':sha(after),'reverse_restored_sha256':sha(reverse),'reverse_restores_exact_snapshot':True,'target_external_bytes_unchanged':True,'record_count':len(rows),'changed_records':diffs,'all_unchanged_records_identical':True,'source_source_tag_args_order_special_function_section_line_preserved':True})
checks={}
for name,cmd in [('strict_lint',['python3','-B','tools/i18n','lint','--strict']),('git_diff_check',['git','diff','--check'])]:
    r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
    (val/(name+'.stdout.txt')).write_text(r.stdout)
    (val/(name+'.stderr.txt')).write_text(r.stderr)
    checks[name]={'command':' '.join(cmd),'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':str((val/(name+'.stdout.txt')).relative_to(root)),'stderr':str((val/(name+'.stderr.txt')).relative_to(root))}
    print(name,r.returncode,r.stdout[-2500:],r.stderr[-500:])
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--stat'],check=True,stdout=(val/'git-diff-stat.txt').open('w'))
# Snapshot-relative diff covers only this dispatch, despite preexisting worktree changes.
for file in files:
    r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--',str((task/'before-fix-1'/file).relative_to(root)),file],capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert r.returncode==1
    (val/(file+'.diff')).write_text(r.stdout)
unchanged=all((root/p).is_file() and sha((root/p).read_bytes())==h for p,h in protected_hash.items())
assert unchanged
assert sha(index.read_bytes())==index_hash
report={'task_id':'mechanics-rollback-20261003','dispatch':'fix-1','status':'completed' if all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in checks.values()) else 'validation_failed','scope':'Only FIX-1 confirmed inventory IDs 51,73,82,118; no game source reinterpretation','changes':changes,'proof':proof,'validation':dict(doctor={'command':'python3 -B tools/i18n doctor','exit_code':0,'runtime':'Lua 5.1 / LuaJIT 2.1.0-beta3','lpeg':'0.10.2-1 (0.10)','warnings':'Existing unpinned DLC source warnings'},**checks),'protected_files':{'count':len(protected_hash),'all_bytes_unchanged':unchanged,'sha256_before':protected_hash,'git_index_unchanged':True,'previous_executor_report_unchanged':True},'plan_deviations':[],'unresolved_issues':[],'additional_writes':['.ai/task/mechanics-rollback-20261003/fix-1-validation/','.artifacts/i18n/mechanics-rollback-20261003/fix-1-report.json','/tmp/mechanics-rollback-fix-1.py','strict lint default derived .artifacts/i18n/runs/']}
out=root/fix['extra_report']
out.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Report:',str(out.relative_to(root)))
print('Proof: 4 target-only changes; reverse bytes and all LuaJIT non-target fields match; protected files and git index unchanged.')
assert report['status']=='completed'
PY
python3 -B /tmp/mechanics-rollback-fix-1.py","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":2500}));
